---
title: 'Appendix A — Full event-study estimates (Tables A.1, A.2)'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Table A.1: k = 8

```{r}
m8_nc <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df = data,
  outcome = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group = "id",
  time = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects = 8,
  placebo = 8
)
print(m8_nc)
```

## Table A.2

Each chunk prints one row of Table A.2: k, joint p-values (effects, placebos), average cumulative effect (estimate, SE, CI), average number of quarters over which the effect accumulates.

### k = 1

```{r}
m1_nc <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df = data,
  outcome = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group = "id",
  time = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects = 1,
  placebo = 1
)
c(
  k = 1,
  m1_nc$results$ATE[1, 1:4],
  quarters = m1_nc$results$delta_D_avg_total
)
```

### k = 2

```{r}
m2_nc <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df = data,
  outcome = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group = "id",
  time = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects = 2,
  placebo = 2
)
c(
  k = 2,
  p_effects = m2_nc$results$p_jointeffects,
  p_placebos = m2_nc$results$p_jointplacebo,
  m2_nc$results$ATE[1, 1:4],
  quarters = m2_nc$results$delta_D_avg_total
)
```
